_comment: Display Template preset: a Response of summaries and charts. See ../../codebot/display_template.md#display-presets. Copy this file's 'rules' array into your project's display.json (../../reference/presentation.md#display-template-file) and rename every placeholder below to your own schema names, then remove this and the '_placeholders' member.

_placeholders.summary: A direct field of Dashboard holding one or more summary values, declared as its own Table type.
_placeholders.chart: Any other direct field of Dashboard, such as a chart root; rename or add fields to the split's second region as needed.
_placeholders.lines: A direct field of Dashboard: a List of small Tables long enough to want a table on wide screens.
_placeholders.LineItem: The Table type of the 'lines' List's members; 'amount' below is one of its scalar fields.
